title: Serving Benchmark Request
description: What an onboarding serving benchmark ran (bench_request.json, returned as output_files.bench_request). Run the same client_args against a changed server and the two summaries differ only by the change.

client_args.description: serving_benchmark.py's arguments, verbatim (for a sweep, those after `--`), without --base-url and --output-dir.

server.description: The server measured (a sweep's leader): job_id, and when known compute_profile, image, deployments_json, launch_recipe.

sweep.description: sweep only: what serving_sweep.py run was given besides client_args (sweep_plan, recipe, server_inputs, max_model_len).

results_json.description: Path to the client's summary.json (a sweep's merged one).
